description: The only data sources dashboards and alert rules may reference, by fixed uid. scripts/observability/validate.py enforces it. The grafanacloud-* uids are the Grafana Cloud defaults: confirm them on the real stack (Connections -> Data sources) in phase 1 and change them only here and in the files that use them.

datasources.note: Created by infra (module.observability) with this fixed uid. Logs in as grafana_reader, which can read only the monitoring.* views below.
Grafana Cloud metrics: the Supabase scrape job, Synthetic Monitoring (probe_*), OTel gauges (house_ingest_*, gha_workflow_*).
Grafana Cloud logs: Faro (Frontend Observability) events, exceptions and measurements.
Grafana Cloud traces: Faro fetch spans, send-push, ingest and CI traces.
Grafana Cloud usage and billing metrics (grafanacloud_*).
